_readme: Coming up near you: dated, money-related events by country (and US state). Official sources only.

status "confirmed": announced by the official source for these dates. status "expected": a recurring event that hasn't been announced yet — dates are from last time (say so in based_on) and the app shows it as Check.
issuers: card issuers (as in seed/card_benefits.json) whose cardholders it's for; empty = everyone in the country. regions: US state codes; empty = the whole country.
card_keywords: words a held card's product name must contain (e.g. "mastercard"), for promotions on one card type; empty = any card from those issuers.
Keep this list current: add new announcements and roll "expected" events forward when the source confirms them. Run `npm run seed:build -- --migration` after editing.

events.title: Free entry to national parks
events.summary: Entrance fees waived for US citizens and residents on Theodore Roosevelt's birthday. Camping and reservation fees still apply.

events.title: Free entry to national parks (Veterans Day)
events.summary: Entrance fees waived for US citizens and residents. Camping and reservation fees still apply.

events.title: Medicare Open Enrollment
events.summary: Change your Medicare Advantage or drug plan for 2027, or switch between Original Medicare and Medicare Advantage. Plans must get your form by December 7.

events.title: Health Insurance Marketplace enrollment
events.summary: Enroll by December 15 for coverage from January 1, or by January 15 for February 1. Oregon uses its own site from this year.

events.title: Spend your FSA before the year ends
events.summary: If your health FSA runs on the calendar year, money left after December 31 is lost — unless your plan has a grace period or carryover.
events.based_on: The deadline depends on your plan year; most plans follow the calendar year.

events.title: Scotiabank Mastercard Divali cash back
events.summary: Last year: 5% cash back on Scotiabank Mastercard purchases, capped at TT$200–250 depending on the card. Check whether it's running this year.

events.title: Scotiabank Visa Christmas cash back
events.summary: Last year: cash back for reaching a personal spending goal on local Visa purchases, sent by email. Open those emails — it was a condition.
